items.difficulty_reason: The pairing identifies J with Hom_B(omega_{B/A}, B) for flat quasi-finite maps: finite flat free case computed on a basis (sum b_i tensor c_i maps to the functional sending b_i^vee to c_i, with the reverse inclusion via xi = sum b_i tensor phi(b_i^vee)), then the general case by the etale-split reduction with base-change and product compatibilities of J, omega and the pairing, closing by faithful flatness. Retained author proof at lines 1434-1482.
